newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian rate outlook unchanged after FOMC.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian rate outlook unchanged after FOMC.

text.p: Australian interest rates remained on track for a fourth quarter cut, with Tuesday's decision to leave U.S. rates unchanged seen having little direct impact on the local rate outlook, economists said.
After the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) decided to leave U.S. interest rates unchanged, economists said a local cut would have remained on the cards even if U.S. rates had risen.
"I don't think it (the Fed inaction) either increases or decreases the chance of an easing here," Colonial State Bank senior economist Craig James said.
